body.x: Computers, smartphones, tablets, refrigerators, washing machines, air conditioners… these are the electronic gadgets that come to mind for most people.

However, there’s something that we mustn’t forget – the fact that, small and unimportant as they may be, we use more useful electronic appliances in our daily lives than we may realize. And with daily advances in IT technology, even the most commonplace items are becoming electronic.

One example of this at KES 2012 is the Smart TWOWING Pencil Case by Huro. There’s nothing too complicated about the product. A basic pencil case lid is enhanced with features including an LED display and a digital lock. Also built into the product are an electronic lock that works with a key code or a pattern, a photo frame that can display a funny character or a picture, and a game mode using buttons and the LED. Inside the lid is a little board for writing notes. The buttons are part of a capacitive touch screen that vibrates when pressed. The product comes in five colors: pink, blue, green, violet, and black.

Huro, the company that designed the Smart TWOWING Pencil Case, is a firm that develops new products that fuse IT technology with items from our everyday live. Their objective is to make users’ lives a little more convenient through this integration. As of now, they have registered ten patents, five trademarks and two designs and have filed six patents in Korea and one abroad.
